text: 5/15 in Marbury VC58 last night. Nothing new but 6 Oak Beauties was a garden record. Like Mervs it is going to be one of those moths I never tire of! Also  3 Small Quakers,  2 Common Quakers, a Clouded Drab and 3 Acleris hastiana agg #teammoth
A Hebrew Character found and photographed by my wife Alison this morning here in East Lothian, Scotland. #TeamMoth

Also in St Mellion, my first ever female Early Moth, which was clinging on to the railings next to the moth trap. And this attractive chestnut coloured Twin-spotted Quaker was among 3 taken. Other highlights were Red Chestnut and 7 Early Grey. #teammoth

42 moths of 12 species in St Mellion last night. The largely clear skies & cool wind probably kept any migrant activity to a minimum (hopefully tonight!). New for the year were - Plutella xylostella (Diamond-back Moth), Yellow Horned & Mottled Grey, making it 40 species recorded this year #teammoth
